name: Memory (MemGPT)
description: MemGPT three-tier memory architecture for OpenClaw — core, archival, and recall memory via a Python FastAPI sidecar wrapping the pymemgpt fork.

namespace.description: Memory namespace — maps to agent_config.name in the sidecar. Shared across agents when two plugin instances use the same value. Defaults to 'default'.

model.description: LLM model passed to the sidecar on agent creation (create branch only).

persona.description: Persona string written into core memory on agent creation.

human.description: Human string written into core memory on agent creation.

sidecarUrl.description: Override the sidecar base URL (OPENCLAW_MEMGPT_SIDECAR_URL). When absent the plugin spawns and manages the sidecar process.

provider.description: LLM provider for the sidecar. Set by `openclaw memgpt setup`.

baseUrl.description: Sidecar LLM base URL (→ OPENAI_API_BASE). Required for openai-compatible; preset default otherwise.

credential.description: Credential reference (never the secret). Set by `openclaw memgpt setup`.

var.description: Env var holding the API key (source=env only).
